notes: forasmuch as is fused across כִּי עַל־כֵּן under rule 30's one-rendering condition, no morpheme owning a part of the compound conjunction; the competing split is named in the unit note.

The supplied how is the verse's one `added` unit: rules 48 and 52 put a recast clause's complementizer on a preposition, and no preposition or conjunction stands before חֲנֹתֵנוּ to carry it, so rule 55's count marks it in surplus.
נָא takes the complete entreaty formula including its pronouns, headed on pray (rule 30).
